# Part 17 · Saved Tokens. Wrong City.

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeEbehLRSeM/) · Published 4 Oct 2026

> Should an agent remember with a running summary or a memory graph?

At turn 5 the customer says Pune. At turn 40, Chennai. Four summary rewrites later, both cities are in the summary and nothing says which one is newer.

![Whiteboard for Part 17](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Keep the raw turns. The summary only points into them. For a delivery chat, that's turns 5 and 40.
2. Store every fact as entity, property, value and a timestamp. The newest value on a key wins. For this order, deliver_to = Chennai.
3. Fix the property names before the first write and reject the rest. For this order, deliver_to, never shipping_city.

## The code

[`memory_store.py`](memory_store.py). A rolling summary that ends up holding both cities, next to a graph where the newest value on a key wins and unknown property names are rejected.

```bash
python memory_store.py
```

Standard library only. Running it executes the self-test.
